utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive, Dane. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m just catching up, but I can take the rest of it if you tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, start with the inventory list and I’ll handle the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that. What time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare tarps and some screws if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I can use those. I’ll grab them if I need to patch anything up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Take what you need — I’ll keep the rest set aside for whoever comes by next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need to figure out what’s been ordered, and whether we have enough hands and materials for the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort that out. Want me to check the order list with you and see what else we still need for the afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it's mostly loose hardware and a couple of door latches, but Mina would know the full list better than I do.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive's moving along nicely. Folks around here are pitching in, so it should be a good turn out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, sounds like a good turnout. I’ve got a few spare tools if anybody ends up needing one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s generous of you, Gus. I’ll let folks know you’ve got tools on hand in case anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together the repair drive list now, and I’ll spread the word to the neighbors this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I can help keep track of who still needs a note once you’ve got the list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll start reaching out and send you anyone who still needs a note as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check the list and see what’s still open, or you can tell me the remaining items and I’ll help track them down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep you posted on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Bo. I’ll keep you posted as things come in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll pass the plan along and keep people posted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye on the updates and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep passing the plan along and make sure everyone stays posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive — I almost forgot. I’m in; just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Could you start with the eastern side? I’ll show you the rest in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll head over there now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I can help round up a few more hands for the repair drive if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be a big help, thanks. I can use the extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll start calling folks right now and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m definitely in for the repair drive. I’ll tell a few neighbors and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Count me in, even if I’m a little late. I can still help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, that helps a lot. I’ll spread the word and let folks know we’ve got another hand on deck.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help once I know what needs fixing for the repair drive. What’s the current snag?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The snag is a bad cord on the work light, and I need the bulb checked too. I’ll bring both so we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it. I’ll check the cord and the bulb when you bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school pickup, but I need to know what time the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 4:30. If you can make it after pickup, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I can be there right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word if you want. What part of the repair drive needs the most attention?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly the loose roof patch and a couple of fence boards, but I can keep repeating the plan so folks know where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That should help a lot. I’ll tell folks the roof patch and fence boards are the priorities, and they can come back to your repeating the plan for details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that if you need a tool.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help, but I need to know where it’s coming from and how much time we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can tell you that part: the tool’s from my shed, and I can spare it for an hour or two.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where things are headed for the repair drive. What do you need me to note?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just note the main pickup spots and whether anything needs a truck or extra hands. I’ll keep the list organized from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the main pickup spots and mark whether any need a truck or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the total again, but I think we still need a little more.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much more do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I could use you on the tools and the heavier lifting. If you can bring a drill and some screws, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can bring the drill and some screws, and I’ll handle the heavier lifting too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive happening, but I only got that second-hand. Did Noah say what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think the porch screen and one of the gate latches were still on the list. I might be missing another thing, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, that sounds like the porch screen and gate latch are still on the list. I’ll keep an ear out in case there’s one more thing too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s today. I heard they’re starting a little later than planned, so keep an ear out for them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure I’m ready for it, then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along; I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem, I’ll check in after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Leo, I might be a little fuzzy, but I’m pretty sure the repair drive is today. I can come by and help if you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, if you can make it, I could use the extra set of hands. Come by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll head over soon and lend a hand.
